name: Golden Minerals Company
summary: Golden Minerals Company functions as a precious metals firm, involved in the exploration, development, and extraction of mineral properties. Its primary focus is on valuable metals like gold and silver, but it also targets zinc, lead, and other significant minerals. The company boasts full ownership (100% interest) of several key assets in Mexico's Durango State, including the Rodeo gold mine, as well as the Velardeña and Chicago gold-silver mining sites, which come equipped with their own oxide and sulfide processing facilities. Additionally, Golden Minerals entirely owns the El Quevar advanced silver exploration property in Salta province, Argentina. It further maintains a diverse portfolio of other precious metals and mineral exploration prospects spread across Argentina, Nevada, and Mexico. Established in 1996 and headquartered in Golden, Colorado, the firm adopted its current name, Golden Minerals Company, in March 2009, having previously operated as Apex Silver Mines Limited.
